text: とりが　へばちゃって　もどれないぞ　…　どうしよう

structure.jp: とりが　へばちゃって
structure.en: my bird got completely worn out, and

patterns.name: 〜てしまう
patterns.explanation: ちゃって is the shortened spoken form of てしまって. It says the thing happened completely, to your regret. へばちゃって = 'it went and got worn out, so'.

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: This verb ending changes 'go back' into 'can go back', and ない makes it 'cannot'. もどれない = 'can't get back'.

patterns.name: 〜ぞ
patterns.explanation: ぞ at the end is a rough, mostly male way to stress what you just said. もどれないぞ = 'I can't get back, I tell you'.
